primary.title: Blanket GRANT removal blocked — manifest does not cover all physical tables
primary.detail: Cross-checked every pgTable(...) declaration in the repository against the 700-entry manifest: 111 physical tables have a real declaration but no manifest entry at all (never reviewed/classified). Sample: members, tenants, strike_funds, budgets, vendors, encryption_keys, pii_access_log — all declared only in services/financial-service's own separate schema files. That service's actual DB-role story relative to union_eyes_runtime/union_eyes_system was not verified this round. Revoking 0108's blanket GRANT now would risk silently removing all runtime/system access to those 111 tables. Mandate sections 42/44/46/50 (blanket grant removal, sequence audit, ACL oracle against 'final full cutover') are therefore NOT done — this is the primary reason Round 58C is PARTIAL, not CLOSED.
requiredFollowUp: Determine financial-service's actual DB connection/role (own credentials vs union_eyes_runtime/system)
If shared, classify/manifest all ~111 tables, or formally establish financial-service as a SEPARATE_DATABASE_BOUNDARY-style exception
Separately audit the ~15 v_*-prefixed names found (likely SQL views, which table-level RLS/FORCE RLS does not reach at all)

verdictReason: Core mandate objective achieved (32 geometry blockers -> 0, via 5 generic parser fixes + 1 manifest reclassification + 26 explicit, evidenced ENFORCEMENT_GEOMETRY_OVERRIDES entries), and extensively re-validated (behavioral, policy-syntax, ACL, and independent-policy oracles all green; full-migration transactional apply+rollback proof green; deployment DAG wired as a safe, non-gating manual job with a passing static contract test). However, a genuine, well-evidenced, newly-discovered blocker (111 physical tables absent from the manifest) prevents completing the mandate's blanket-grant-removal requirement (sections 42/44/46/50), which is a hard prerequisite for ROUND58C = CLOSED per section 70's close gate.
